title: I've been using xDrip for about a year with the G5, I've had only one transmitter last past 90 days...Dexcom is starting to ask questions.
symptom: The user reports that their Dexcom G5 transmitter lasted only 13.5 days, and they have had only one transmitter last past 90 days in a year of use. They wonder if xDrip could be causing this.
cause: A commenter suggests that transmitters activate in the box before use, draining the battery before the user starts using them.
evidence_quote: As far as I know they just activate in the box before they are even put in to use and that drains the battery before you start.
